entries.name: Aegis
entries.description: The Bulwark's big sibling. A shield that walks, built to make you waste time you don't have.

entries.name: Bulwark
entries.description: A slab of iron with no gun and no fear. It exists to soak your bullets while others do the work.

entries.name: Chanter
entries.description: Rings a warning before its circle of bells tolls. When it glows, be elsewhere.

entries.name: Colossus
entries.description: A fortress given legs. Nothing gets through it until everything does.

entries.name: Darter
entries.description: Fast and fragile. It races down before you have time to think about it.

entries.name: Descender
entries.description: The rank and file of the endless host. Falls straight, fires straight, and dies fast - but never comes alone.

entries.name: Harbinger
entries.description: A turning wheel of violet omens. Its gyre rotates - the safe angle never stays.

entries.name: Hexblade
entries.description: Twin blades that snake as they fall. The wall bends - you must bend more.

entries.name: Hexer
entries.description: Curses the air with slow crossing bolts. Weak alone, monstrous in a crowd.

entries.name: Hunter
entries.description: Tracks your position and dives. If you hear nothing else: keep moving.

entries.name: Lancer
entries.description: Its bolt leaves the barrel lazy and arrives like a thunderclap. Dodge early, not late.

entries.name: Marauder
entries.description: Pressure incarnate: twin arcs of red, over and over, until something breaks.

entries.name: Orbiter
entries.description: Pins the airspace with a cross of four bolts. The gaps are your lanes - learn them.

entries.name: Pyromancer
entries.description: Its fan of fire starts lazy and pounces. The safe spot you see now is already gone.

entries.name: Ravager
entries.description: Slow, heavy, and patient. Its bolt hunts you for a moment before flying true - outrun it.

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.description: A patient eye that leads its single shot straight at you. The first enemy that aims.

entries.name: Skirmisher
entries.description: A weaving sniper that never stops moving and never stops aiming.

entries.name: Spinner
entries.description: Trails a lazy spiral of shots behind it - the lane it leaves is never the lane you remember.

entries.name: Warden
entries.description: A lantern that guards the walls. Hides behind shields and sends hunting bolts around them.

entries.name: Warlock
entries.description: Carries a ring of violet fire and lets it loose all at once. Keep your distance from the blast.

entries.name: Weaver
entries.description: Drifts side to side on its way down, lobbing arcs that punish anyone standing still.

entries.name: Wisp
entries.description: A harmless-looking mote that kills by touch. Swarms are the point.

entries.name: Zealot
entries.description: A blade of white gold that dives like judgement. Its bolt accelerates - so does it.

entries.name: Archon
entries.description: A star of judgement. Its wrath calls zealots; its ascension calls wardens; its light calls walls.

entries.name: Behemoth
entries.description: A wall of iron that learned to fight back. Everything it throws is heavy.

entries.name: Herald
entries.description: It announces the wall, then becomes it. Walk through the gaps it deigns to leave.

entries.name: Lich
entries.description: Green curtains of grave-light, swaying as they fall. Below half, the phalanx marches.

entries.name: Monarch
entries.description: The old king of the endless host. Three reigns, each crueller than the last.

entries.name: Oblivion
entries.description: The last thing far runs see. Dense rings, a turning spiral, and the dark that follows you home.

entries.name: Serpent
entries.description: Spits from both fangs and crosses its own fire. The lattice tightens as it bleeds.

entries.name: Stormcaller
entries.description: The storm follows you. Crosses of violet lightning turn about it as it hunts.

entries.name: Summoner
entries.description: It does not fight you. It invites others to - and rings its bell while you drown.

entries.name: Tyrant
entries.description: Triple-aimed volleys and a ring it wears like a crown. It does not tolerate standing still.

entries.name: FirstBoss
entries.description: The gatekeeper. Every knight meets it first, and most meet it again.
